items.title: Computational thinking ki rozmarra zindagi se misalein (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: Real-life examples of Computational Thinking and Figure 2.1 (printed page 21, read from a second copy of the book; not in this scan).

blocks.text: Rozana ka time table (nizam-ul-auqaat) banana computational thinking ki misal hai. Recipe (khana banane ka tareeqa) se khana pakana step-by-step hidayat (instructions) par chalna hai. Safar ki planning mein kaamon ko chhote hisson mein toda jata hai. Kitabon ko subject ya size ke hisaab se lagana pattern recognition (milti julti cheezein pehchanna) hai. Mobile phone ka masla theek karna logical thinking (mantiqi soch) hai. Paise sambhalne ke liye planning aur decision making (faisla karna) chahiye. Strategy games (chaal wale khel) mein aage ka sochna parta hai. Yeh sab kaam rozmarra zindagi mein computational thinking hain (Figure 2.1 dekhein).

blocks.alt: Computational Thinking in Daily Life ke unwan ke neeche ek teer (arrow) par chaar number wale hisse: 1 Decomposition, Break Down the Problem (bara box chaar chhote boxes mein toota hua); 2 Pattern Recognition, Find Patterns (circle aur square ka jora baar baar, agli shakal ki jagah sawal ka nishan); 3 Abstraction, Focus on What's Important (bohat si shaklein ek funnel (qeef) mein, neeche sirf ek nikalti hai); 4 Algorithm Design, Create Step-by-Step Solution (number wale steps ki list aur tick).
blocks.caption: Figure 2.1: Computational Thinking in Daily Life (our drawing of the book's figure)

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Figure 2.1 computational thinking ke chaar steps baayein se daayein tarteeb se dikhati hai. 1. Decomposition (masle ko torna): bara kaam chhote hisson (a, b, c, d) mein toot jata hai. 2. Pattern Recognition (naqsh pehchanna): circle-square ka jora dohraya ja raha hai, is liye agli shakal circle hogi. 3. Abstraction (sirf zaroori par dhyan): funnel bohat si cheezon mein se sirf woh cheez aage bhejta hai jo kaam ki hai. 4. Algorithm Design (hal ke steps banana): aakhir mein number wale saaf steps ki list banti hai. Teer (arrow) batata hai ke yeh steps aik ke baad aik aate hain. Tasveerein hamari banayi hui hain; labels kitab wale hain.

blocks.caption: Misal aur us mein computational thinking ka hissa
rows: Kitabein subject ya size se lagana

blocks.prompt: Apne school bag ko subah tayyar karne ka kaam lein. Is mein decomposition aur algorithm kahan hain?
blocks.explanation: Decomposition: kaam ko hisson mein torein: time table dekhna, kitabein aur copiyan rakhna, pencil box check karna, lunch aur paani ki bottle rakhna. Algorithm: in hisson ko sahi tarteeb mein likh lein (pehle time table dekhein, phir kitabein rakhein, aakhir mein lunch), taake har roz yahi steps follow ho sakein aur koi cheez na bhoolein.

items: Time table, recipe, safar ki planning, kitabein lagana, mobile theek karna, paise sambhalna aur strategy games: sab computational thinking hain.
Figure 2.1: Decomposition, Pattern Recognition, Abstraction, Algorithm Design, isi tarteeb mein.
